coverageMeaning: Each production file individually read and assessed against actual input dimensions; no-candidate is scoped static review, not a performance guarantee.

entries.notes: Runtime fixed-grammar validation/builders/identity wrappers, with input-string/own-key/array length costs where present; no independent growing search loop.
Key hash and whole payload read/parse/canonical snapshot/write; compute/parser trusted unknown. No directory scan; no single-flight is explicit contract.
Dynamic region key table triggers shared closed exact-key Θ(R²); then one batch collection/final rebuild and indexed lookups, full text output sensitive.
Bounded preview but omitted callback receives full copied tail; Θ(F) by public callback contract; messages append copy per actual call.
Waiver canonical identity map and one finding pass: not F×W scan. Identity hashing/canonical text plus full audit output dimensions.
Memo DFS edges linear but each task searches complete prediction array; score reads search complete scores, used inside candidate comparator; ranking count verified.
History series find O(H) with H≤4096, frozen samples W≤32; canonical series ordering required; no claim of unlimited history growth.
T history lookup find with H≤4096/W≤32; public snapshot array task read find; canonical identity plus median/snapshot sort required payload work.
Single load/predict and terminal record closure; forwards known table lookup costs; no independent graph/collection algorithm.
One prediction find per valid admission O(A T), otherwise keyed merged history; temporary H+A before pruning; W≤32 per sample.
Accepted H≤4096/W≤32 envelope parse/freeze; reads whole bytes and shallow array before invalid-size rejection; trusted local I/O/canonical output not measured.
Rebuild static maps every decision; per-candidate activationTaskIds.includes creates O(k a_max), shared inactive-scope a=k yields Θ(k²); no real-scope probe.
Layers costs inherited; sorting k items to select first O(k log k), no measured bottleneck or changed order contract.
Prepared prediction/score tables then score find in each candidate comparison; repeated layers projection; callback identity/observer arbitrary cost unknown.
